name: Anthill Front · Difficulty 2 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Keep the amber queen alive and destroy the rival queen. Assign one worker to the visible listening front until contact is acquired, one worker to excavate the brood, and the others to gather seeds; then raise soldiers. When each marked intercept point is held, use the formation's visible approach and settling lane to choose the NORTH or SOUTH tunnel. Assault the rival queen only after every raid is cleared. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Programs in an isolated agent sandbox may process screenshots and issue mouse and keyboard actions through the provided gateway. Do not access the task environment through Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, DOM or page-state inspection, the task terminal or shell, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.
